body.name: \(\mathcal C_n(\alpha)\)
body.construction: When \(\eta_{S,n}<1\) and every \(\eta_{a,n}<1\), set \(r_{S,n}(\alpha)=((1-\eta_{S,n})^{-2}-1)\lVert\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{pair}}^{SS}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\) and \(r_{a,n}(\alpha)=((1-\eta_{a,n})^{-2}-1)\lVert\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{marg}}^{aa}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\). Define \(\mathcal C_n(\alpha)=\{\mathcal O'_S:\lVert\Sigma'^{SS}-\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{pair}}^{SS}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\le r_{S,n}(\alpha),\ \lVert\Sigma'^{aa}-\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{marg}}^{aa}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\le r_{a,n}(\alpha)\ \text{for every }a\in M,\ \Sigma'^{SS}\succ0,\ \Sigma'^{aa}\succ0\}\), where \(\eta_{S,n}=\sqrt{d_S/n_S}+\sqrt{2\log(2K_{\mathrm{obs}}/\alpha)/n_S}\) and \(\eta_{a,n}=\sqrt{p/n_a}+\sqrt{2\log(2K_{\mathrm{obs}}/\alpha)/n_a}\).
